//: Secrets are deliberately empty here and are never committed with a value. They are supplied by dotnet user-secrets in Development and by environment variables in Production. See docs/api-windows-service.md.

Upload.//: Largest accepted manual notice upload, in bytes. Anything larger is refused with 413. Default 32 MB.

Ops.//: Install paths reported on the cards. DeployHistoryPath is what the deploy workflows append to — tailed as Deploy Actions once those workflows write it. ProbeTimeoutMilliseconds (2000) bounds the database check so a down database cannot stall the 5s poll.
